heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 夏爾·戴高樂1890年11月22日生於里爾，在家中五個孩子裡排行第三。1908年他進入聖西爾軍校，1912年被分到阿拉斯的第33步兵團，團長是貝當上校。一戰期間，上尉戴高樂作戰勇敢，1916年3月被德軍俘虜，並五次嘗試逃跑。
body.en: Charles de Gaulle was born in Lille on 22 November 1890, the third of five children. He was admitted to Saint-Cyr in 1908, and in 1912 joined the 33rd Infantry Regiment at Arras under Colonel Pétain. In the First World War Captain de Gaulle distinguished himself by his bravery; he was captured by the Germans in March 1916 and tried to escape five times.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年4月，戴高樂獲派到波蘭自治軍；1922年返回法國，進入戰爭學院。他在《邁向職業軍隊》（1934年）中主張使用裝甲軍團。戰爭爆發時他是上校，在梅斯指揮第507戰車團；1940年5月25日獲臨時准將，6月6日雷諾任命他為戰爭與國防國務次長。
body.en: In April 1919 de Gaulle was detached to the Autonomous Polish Army; in 1922 he returned to France and entered the École de guerre. In Vers l’armée de métier (1934) he advocated the use of an armoured corps. When war broke out he was a colonel commanding the 507th tank regiment at Metz; on 25 May 1940 he was made temporary general, and on 6 June Paul Reynaud appointed him under-secretary of state for War and National Defence.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月9日，戴高樂會見英國首相邱吉爾；6月16日他得知法國請求停戰，立刻再赴倫敦繼續作戰。6月18日的號召是自由法國軍隊的奠基之舉，他出任領袖；6月27日邱吉爾承認他為自由法國領袖。1944年6月14日他在諾曼第登陸；9月9日成立由他主持的臨時政府。
body.en: On 9 June 1940 de Gaulle met the British prime minister, Winston Churchill; on 16 June, learning of the request for an armistice, he returned at once to London to continue the war. His appeal of 18 June was the founding act of the Free French Forces, which he headed; on 27 June Churchill recognised him as leader of the Free French. On 14 June 1944 he landed in Normandy, and on 9 September 1944 a provisional government presided over by him was founded.

body.zh-Hant: 約瑟夫·霞飛1852年1月12日生於魯西永的里韋薩爾特，父親是富裕的葡萄種植者。1869年他考入巴黎綜合理工學院；一年後以工兵少尉身分參加戰爭，1876年晉升上尉。
body.en: Joseph Joffre was born at Rivesaltes on 12 January 1852, the son of a well-off wine-grower. In 1869 he passed the entrance examination of the École Polytechnique; a year later he took part in the war as a second lieutenant of engineers, and he was promoted captain in 1876.

body.zh-Hant: 1885年霞飛被派往海外，先到東京，再到蘇丹負責修建鐵路，並成為廷巴克圖的掌控者而升中校。他1897年升上校，1902年在馬達加斯加停留後晉升准將，1905年任師長，1910年成為最高戰爭委員會成員。
body.en: In 1885 Joffre was posted overseas, first to Tonkin and then to the Sudan, where he was put in charge of building a railway and became master of Timbuktu, which earned him promotion to lieutenant-colonel. He became colonel in 1897, received his brigadier-general’s stars in 1902 after a stay in Madagascar, was a divisional general in 1905, and in 1910 was named a member of the Conseil supérieur de la guerre.

heading.en: Chief of the general staff and 1914–1916

body.zh-Hant: 1911年，霞飛被選為總參謀長。第一次世界大戰初期，法國把馬恩河的勝利歸功於他。但身為總司令，他也要為凡爾登的深陷和索姆河攻勢的失敗負責，因此被奪去部分職權，由尼韋勒接替；他於1916年12月25日晉升法國元帥。
body.en: In 1911 Joffre was chosen as chief of the general staff. At the start of the First World War France owed him the victory of the Marne. But as generalissimo he was also held answerable for the tragic bogging down of the armies at Verdun and for the failure of the Somme offensive; he lost part of his responsibilities and was replaced by General Nivelle. He was made Marshal of France on 25 December 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 元帥晉升之後，霞飛的角色只剩出國使命，目的地是日本和美洲。1919年7月14日他與福煦、貝當一同參加勝利閱兵；他1918年2月14日當選法蘭西學術院院士，1931年1月3日逝世。
body.en: After becoming marshal, Joffre’s role was limited to missions abroad, to Japan and America. On 14 July 1919 he marched alongside Foch and Pétain in the Victory parade; he had been elected to the Académie française on 14 February 1918, and he died on 3 January 1931.

body.zh-Hant: 菲利普·貝當1856年4月24日生於加萊海峽省的科希拉圖爾，出身貧寒農家，1876年進入聖西爾軍校。1904年他任戰爭學院副教授，主張防禦與陣地戰；第一次世界大戰前夕，58歲的上校貝當正準備退休。
body.en: Philippe Pétain was born at Cauchy-la-Tour in the Pas-de-Calais on 24 April 1856, of a modest peasant family, and entered Saint-Cyr in 1876. In 1904 he became assistant professor at the École de guerre, advocating the defensive and positional warfare; on the eve of the First World War, Colonel Pétain, aged 58, was about to retire.

heading.en: The First World War and Verdun

body.zh-Hant: 戰爭開始後，貝當因在比利時率領步兵旅表現突出而迅速升准將，隨後晉升軍長，在阿圖瓦戰役取得成功。1916年2月他受命指揮凡爾登的部隊，同年春天成為中央集團軍司令；1917年尼韋勒攻勢失敗後，他被任命為法軍總司令，任務是平息兵變，並於1918年11月獲元帥杖。
body.en: Once war broke out, Pétain was rapidly promoted brigadier general after distinguishing himself leading an infantry brigade in Belgium, then corps general, and won brilliant successes in the battles of Artois. In February 1916 he was given command of the troops at Verdun; in spring 1916 he was named commander of the Armies of the Centre. In 1917, after Nivelle’s disastrous offensive, he was promoted commander-in-chief of the French army with the mission of ending the mutinies, and received his marshal’s baton in November 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 1925年貝當被派往摩洛哥，對抗阿卜杜勒·克里姆的叛亂；1931年任國土防空督察，1934年任杜梅格內閣的戰爭部長，任內開始修建馬其諾防線。1929年6月20日他當選法蘭西學術院院士。後來達拉第派他任駐佛朗哥西班牙大使。
body.en: In 1925 Pétain was sent to Morocco to fight Abd el-Krim’s rebellion; in 1931 he became inspector of the territory’s air defence, and in 1934 minister of war in the Doumergue cabinet, under whom construction of the Maginot Line was undertaken. He was elected to the Académie française on 20 June 1929. Daladier later sent him as ambassador to Franco’s Spain.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年法國戰敗後，保羅·雷諾求助於「凡爾登的勝利者」貝當，貝當主張簽署停戰。停戰協定簽後，他經國民議會表決取得全權，成為法蘭西國家元首並實行與希特勒合作的政策，直到1944年8月；他的審判於1945年7月開始，判處死刑後獲赦免。
body.en: After the defeat of 1940, Paul Reynaud turned to “the victor of Verdun”, and the marshal favoured signing an armistice. Once it was signed, Pétain obtained full powers by a vote of the National Assembly, became head of the French State and pursued a policy of collaboration with Hitler, remaining in power until August 1944; his trial opened in July 1945 and he was sentenced to death, then pardoned.

body.zh-Hant: 讓·德·拉特爾·德·塔西尼1889年2月2日生於旺代的穆耶龍昂帕雷，出身佛蘭德古老貴族家庭，在普瓦捷的聖約瑟學院受教育。1908年他考入聖西爾軍校，1909至1911年在校；1911年入索米爾騎兵學校，1912年分到蓬塔穆松的第12龍騎兵團。
body.en: Jean de Lattre de Tassigny was born on 2 February 1889 at Mouilleron-en-Pareds in the Vendée, of an old aristocratic family from French Flanders, and was educated at the Collège Saint-Joseph in Poitiers. He was admitted to Saint-Cyr in 1908 and was a cadet there from 1909 to 1911; he entered the Saumur cavalry school in 1911 and in 1912 was posted to the 12th Dragoons at Pont-à-Mousson.

heading.en: The First World War and the inter-war years

body.zh-Hant: 一戰期間他是第93步兵團的上尉，戰爭結束時帶有4處傷和8次嘉獎。1921年他被派到摩洛哥，在塔紮地區參謀部工作到1926年；1927至1929年進入戰爭學院；1935年升上校，在梅斯指揮第151步兵團；1939年3月23日晉升准將。
body.en: During the First World War he was a captain in the 93rd Infantry Regiment and ended the war with 4 wounds and 8 citations. In 1921 he was sent to Morocco, to the staff of the Taza region until 1926; from 1927 to 1929 he attended the École de guerre; in 1935 he became colonel commanding the 151st Infantry Regiment at Metz; and on 23 March 1939 he was promoted brigadier general.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月2日他任第5集團軍參謀長；1940年1月1日起指揮第14步兵師，與德軍在雷泰勒交戰。1940年7月至1941年9月他任第13軍區司令的副手，之後指揮突尼斯部隊。德軍占領自由區時他拒絕不抵抗的命令而被捕，1943年9月3日從里永監獄逃出，12月20日抵達阿爾及爾。
body.en: On 2 September 1939 he became chief of staff of the 5th Army; from 1 January 1940 he commanded the 14th Infantry Division in the fighting against the Wehrmacht at Rethel. From July 1940 to September 1941 he was deputy to the general commanding the 13th Military Region, and then commanded the troops in Tunisia. When German troops invaded the free zone he refused the order not to fight and was arrested; he escaped from Riom prison on 3 September 1943 and reached Algiers on 20 December 1943.

heading.en: The First Army and the liberation

body.zh-Hant: 1943年12月他指揮B集團軍，後來改稱法國第一集團軍。1944年8月16日他在普羅旺斯登陸，攻占土倫與馬賽，沿隆河谷北上，到萊茵河，解放阿爾薩斯，進入德國直至多瑙河。1945年5月8日他在柏林朱可夫的總部代表法國簽署投降文件。
body.en: In December 1943 he commanded Army B, which became the French First Army. He landed in Provence on 16 August 1944, took Toulon and Marseille, went up the Rhône valley, then the Rhine, liberated Alsace and entered Germany as far as the Danube. On 8 May 1945 he represented France at the signing of the armistice at Marshal Zhukov’s headquarters in Berlin.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年12月至1947年3月他任陸軍總監兼總參謀長；1948年10月至1950年12月任西歐武裝部隊總司令；1950至1952年任印度支那高級專員兼總司令。他於1952年1月11日在巴黎逝世，1月15日葬禮上被追授法國元帥。
body.en: From December 1945 to March 1947 he was inspector general and chief of the general staff of the army; from October 1948 to December 1950 he was commander-in-chief of the Western European armies; and from 1950 to 1952 he was high commissioner and commander-in-chief in Indochina. He died in Paris on 11 January 1952 and was raised to Marshal of France posthumously at his funeral on 15 January.

body.zh-Hant: 費迪南·福煦1851年10月2日生於塔布。1870年戰爭爆發時，他志願加入第4步兵團；留在軍中後進入巴黎綜合理工學院，1873年學業結束，以中尉軍階派往塔布的第24炮兵團。
body.en: Ferdinand Foch was born at Tarbes on 2 October 1851. When war broke out in 1870 he enlisted in the 4th Infantry Regiment; he stayed in the army, entered the École Polytechnique, and after finishing his studies in 1873 was posted as a lieutenant to the 24th Artillery Regiment at Tarbes.

heading.en: Promotions and the École de guerre

body.zh-Hant: 福煦在戰爭學院任教，並於1907至1911年擔任院長。他的軍階依序為：1898年中校、1903年上校、1907年准將、1911年少將、1913年軍長；他在南錫領導第20軍。
body.en: Foch taught at the École de guerre, of which he was director from 1907 to 1911. He rose to lieutenant-colonel in 1898, colonel in 1903, brigadier general in 1907, divisional general in 1911 and corps general in 1913, at the head of the 20th Army Corps at Nancy.

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰爆發時，福煦以第20軍軍長身分參加洛林會戰；隨後率第9集團軍參與馬恩河會戰，也參與了「奔向大海」。他其後出任北方集團軍的指揮官，1915年主持阿圖瓦攻勢，1916年指揮索姆河戰役。
body.en: When the First World War began, Foch took part in the Battle of Lorraine in his corps command, then at the head of the 9th Army fought in the Battle of the Marne and also took part in the “race to the sea”. Appointed to lead the Armies of the North, he directed the Artois offensive in 1915 and the Battle of the Somme in 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 尼韋勒失利後，貝當出任法軍總司令，福煦被任命為總參謀長。1918年春天英國人同意把盟軍的統一指揮權交給他。他於1918年11月11日在雷通德簽署停戰協定，1919年7月14日在勝利閱兵中率領盟軍；他1918年8月6日領元帥杖，1929年3月20日逝世，葬於傷兵院。
body.en: After Nivelle’s setbacks, Pétain took command of the French army and Foch was named chief of the general staff. In spring 1918 the British agreed that the single command of the allied troops be entrusted to him. He signed the armistice at Rethondes on 11 November 1918, led the allied armies in the Victory parade on 14 July 1919, received his marshal’s baton on 6 August 1918, and died on 20 March 1929, being buried at the Invalides.
